title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Programme
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (managed by Campus France)
field: Science and technology, economics and management, law and political science
description: France's flagship scholarship to attract top international students to master's and doctoral programmes at French higher education institutions. Applications are submitted only by the institution on behalf of the candidate.
amount: Monthly allowance of EUR 1,200 (master's) or EUR 2,100 (doctorate) plus airfare, insurance and cultural activities

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (Campus France deadline; institutions set earlier internal dates)

title: France Excellence Major Scholarship
description: Scholarship for the best foreign graduates of French lycees abroad who obtained the French baccalaureate with distinction, funding up to five years of undergraduate and master's study in France.
amount: Monthly allowance, social security cover and, for some, tuition support, for up to 5 years

title: Emile-Boutmy Scholarship
field: Social sciences, political science, international affairs, public policy, economics
description: Sciences Po's scholarship for outstanding international students from outside the EU admitted to a bachelor's or master's programme, awarded on academic merit and the family's financial situation.
amount: Partial to full tuition (up to EUR 19,000 per year for master's) and, in some cases, a living allowance

title: Ampere Excellence Scholarships
provider: Ecole normale superieure de Lyon (ENS de Lyon)
field: Exact sciences, experimental sciences, humanities and social sciences
description: Merit scholarship for outstanding international students admitted to a master's programme at ENS de Lyon, one of France's leading research-intensive grandes ecoles.
amount: EUR 1,000 per month for up to 24 months plus one round-trip airfare

title: Universite Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships
description: Scholarships funded by the university's IDEX initiative for high-achieving international students admitted to an eligible master's programme, aimed at students who are new to the French higher education system.
amount: EUR 10,000 per year plus a possible mobility allowance of EUR 1,000

title: Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA)
field: Climate change, earth system science, energy transition, sustainability
description: Initiative funding international researchers, doctoral and postdoctoral candidates to carry out climate and environmental research projects hosted by French institutions.
amount: Research funding, salary or stipend and mobility support (varies by call)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (France-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, many coordinated by or including French institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
